description: Register a new patient in GNU Health Hospital Information System. Navigate to the Patient module and create a new patient record with the following details: Name 'Marcus Delgado', Date of Birth '1978-11-22', Sex 'Male', Blood Type 'A+', Primary Care Doctor should be set to 'Cordara, Cameron' (a health professional already in the system). Set the patient's Marital Status to 'Married'. Save the patient record. The patient's unique identification (PUID) will be auto-generated by the system.
